ai_policies_scope_id_check.name: ai_policies_scope_id_check
ai_policies_scope_id_check.value:
("ai_policies"."scope" = 'server' AND "ai_policies"."scope_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("ai_policies"."scope" IN ('knowledge_base', 'user') AND "ai_policies"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

claim_arguments_kind_check.name: claim_arguments_kind_check
claim_arguments_kind_check.value:
("claim_arguments"."argument_kind" = 'entity' AND "claim_arguments"."value" IS NULL)
          OR ("claim_arguments"."argument_kind" = 'literal' AND "claim_arguments"."entity_id" IS NULL AND "claim_arguments"."value" IS NOT NULL)

claims_valid_time_check.name: claims_valid_time_check
claims_valid_time_check.value: "claims"."valid_start" IS NULL OR "claims"."valid_end" IS NULL OR "claims"."valid_start" <= "claims"."valid_end"

schema_versions_one_active_uq.name: schema_versions_one_active_uq
schema_versions_one_active_uq.where: is_active = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

source_excerpts_origin_check.name: source_excerpts_origin_check
source_excerpts_origin_check.value:
("source_excerpts"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_excerpts"."note_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("source_excerpts"."source_id" IS NULL AND "source_excerpts"."note_id" IS NOT NULL)

source_excerpts_span_check.name: source_excerpts_span_check
source_excerpts_span_check.value: "source_excerpts"."span_start" IS NULL OR "source_excerpts"."span_end" IS NULL OR "source_excerpts"."span_start" <= "source_excerpts"."span_end"
